text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto was... collapsed on the grass.
Exhausted and completely spent.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Doto. Are you imitating an exhausted soldier?
Though in the race, you seemed rather out of the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hai-eee~, I was so focused on just running that I couldn't even think about the results~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she couldn't match T.M. Opera O,
Meisho Doto somehow managed to finish
the first leg of the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you so muchhh.
Someone clumsy and useless like me... who felt like she'd melt away just entering the Classics...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: At the very least, I was able to make it all the way around without causing anyone troubleee. It's the best memory everrr.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes~. Um, so, as one more thing to remember this by...
choice_data_list: Want to take a commemorative photo or something?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not that...
Would you like to have some snacks on the grass with me?
The breeze feels so nice out here.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaah!
No, that's not what I meant at all...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I guess it's no good after all, huh?
choice_data_list: Sure. But just a little, okay?
Sure. But just a little, okay?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Yes, thank you
very much~. Now then, let's invite everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally, not everyone could make it,
but we enjoyed a modest picnic
in the plaza at the center of the track."
